w10_T4_001175: Bruno stacks more firewood at the scout camp than his friend Lucia does. The woodshed held 178 logs at the start of the week, and Bruno carried in 46 more. The campfires burned 188 logs over the weekend. Lucia split 63 fresh logs and added them to the shed, and a farmer donated 29 logs as well. The camp has 15 tents. The district then asked for 9 sheds to be filled with the same number of logs as this one, and that plan was repeated at all 4 camps in the region. How many logs will the region's camps need in total?
w10_T4_001181: Yusra makes more cheeses each month than her partner Ollie does. The cellar held 47 wheels of cheese at the start of the year, and a new batch added 71 more. The dairy then made enough for the cellar to hold 9 times as many wheels as it did. Half of the wheels in the cellar were sent away to a distributor. Over the summer 411 wheels were sold at the farm gate. How many wheels of cheese are in the cellar now?
w10_T4_001182: On Monday morning the harbour store held 148 boxes of ice, and half of them melted when the freezer failed, though Kemal keeps a fuller store than his colleague Ana does. By the afternoon the supplier had delivered enough for the store to hold 7 times as many boxes as were left. That evening head office topped it up again so that the store held 9 times that number. Over the next week 4228 boxes were used by the trawlers and 417 more went to the fish market. The company now wants 5 stores holding as many boxes as this one has left. How many boxes of ice will the 5 stores hold?
w10_T4_001188: Ada digs more potatoes on the allotment than her neighbour Piotr does. The sack by the gate held 66 potatoes on Monday. Ada added 19 potatoes and Piotr added 25 more to the same sack. On Wednesday another 11 went in, and on Friday a further 34. The allotment path is 40 metres long. The society now wants 8 sacks filled to match this one. How many potatoes will the 8 sacks hold?
w10_T4_001191: On Monday morning Idris set the press running and printed 162 leaflets from each of 3 plates, and he prints more in a day than his colleague Marta does. In the afternoon that same run was repeated on all 8 presses in the workshop. That evening the order was extended to the 7 print shops in the group, each producing the same number of leaflets as the workshop. A courier added 18 hand-finished leaflets to the final count. How many leaflets were printed in total?
w10_T4_001193: A parking meter company counts its takings in whole dollars rather than in cents. One meter held 238 coins on Friday, and a collector dropped in 13 more that had jammed earlier. On Saturday 127 coins were taken out to pay a contractor. The rest were shared equally between the 4 offices in the town, and one office locked its share in a safe. That office then spent 5 coins on stamps and lost 4 down a drain. How many coins does that office have now?
w10_T4_001197: A pharmacy records its stock in single bottles rather than in cases, and Salma fills more prescriptions than her colleague Dan does. The shelf held 106 bottles of cough syrup in October, and 61 were dispensed that month. A delivery in November brought 68 more bottles to the shelf. The pharmacy is open 6 days a week. In December 60 bottles were dispensed, and in January a wholesaler sent 46 bottles. How many bottles of cough syrup are on the shelf now?
w10_T4_001203: Ruth organises more races than her co-organiser Emeka does. The medal box held 202 medals before the marathon, and half of them were given out at the finish line. A sponsor then sent 61 new medals for the box. A club returned 9 medals that had been engraved wrongly, and the engraver delivered 29 more. A school finally donated 71 spare medals to the same box. How many medals are in the box now?
w10_T4_001204: Ingrid keeps more buttons in her sewing box than her sister Marta does. The box held 229 buttons until 147 were sewn onto a coat order. A haberdasher then tripled the number of buttons in the box. Marta borrowed 64 buttons for a costume and never brought them back. A theatre has now ordered 5 boxes, each holding as many buttons as Ingrid's box does. How many buttons will the theatre's order come to?
w10_T4_001205: Kofi builds more model kits than his friend Rosa does. His shelf held 189 kits, he bought 23 more at a fair, and Rosa gave him 47 from her own collection. A museum borrowed 258 of the kits for an exhibition and kept them. His workshop has 40 shelves. A friend then doubled what was left by giving him the same number of kits again, and a club tripled that amount as a competition prize. Kofi finally gave 4 kits away to a school. How many model kits does Kofi have now?
w10_T4_001212: On Monday morning an orchestra librarian counted 108 sheets of music and divided them equally between the 3 sections of the orchestra. She carried the strings' pile to the rehearsal room. Before lunch 34 sheets from that pile blew out of an open window and were lost. In the afternoon the copyist delivered 55 new sheets for the same pile. That evening the conductor doubled the pile so that every player had a spare. The orchestra now needs 9 piles of that size, one for each of its concerts. How many sheets of music are needed in total?
w10_T4_001217: A match factory counts its output in single matches rather than in boxes. Each small box holds 96 matches, and every packet contains 7 boxes. Each carton holds 4 packets, and every crate holds 8 cartons. The factory floor is 60 metres long. An inspector added 46 loose matches to one crate for testing and then dropped in 4 more. How many matches are in that crate?
w10_T4_001224: A vending company loads 143 cans onto each of the 5 shelves of a machine. There are 4 machines of that kind in the college. The company also left 60 spare cans in the college store. The college has 900 students. Demand was so high that the company doubled the whole stock it keeps at the college. A technician then added 3 cans he found in his van. How many cans are at the college now?
w10_T4_001225: On Saturday morning a beach clean began with 100 pieces of litter already in the bin, and before nine o'clock Ivy collected 68 pieces while Callum collected 71, since Callum works faster than Ivy does. The beach is 2 kilometres long. At midday a family added 27 pieces to the bin. In the afternoon a diver brought up 30 pieces from the harbour. In the evening a dog walker added 33 more. How many pieces of litter are in the bin now?
w10_T4_001230: Femi's chocolate line runs faster than Greta's does. The mixing room held 94 slabs of chocolate, and 61 of them were used for a special order. Each remaining slab is cut into 6 bars. A batch of that size is made on each of the 5 lines, and the factory runs 7 such batches every week. Last week 5175 bars were shipped out to shops. How many bars are still in the factory?
w10_T4_001243: A car wash sells its tokens in whole dollars rather than in cents. On Monday morning the kiosk held 108 tokens, and a customer returned 7 unused ones. Before lunch a taxi firm used 24 tokens. In the afternoon the owner ordered enough tokens for the kiosk to hold 6 times as many as were left. That evening the same stock was arranged for each of the 5 kiosks in the chain, and the chain repeated the whole order in all 4 towns where it operates. How many tokens does the chain now hold?
w10_T4_001258: On Friday morning a campsite had 224 pitches free. By lunchtime a festival crowd had booked 91 pitches, and 7 more were taken in the early afternoon. That evening 26 groups left the site and their pitches became free again. On Saturday another 77 pitches were booked. How many pitches are free now?
w10_T4_001260: An art gallery keeps all of its postcards in one display rack. On Monday morning the rack held 137 postcards and 24 were sold before lunch. In the afternoon a printer delivered 46 more, and that evening 6 were ruined by a leak. On Tuesday an artist added 11 postcards to the rack. The gallery has 9 rooms. On Wednesday the gallery ordered enough stock for the rack to hold 8 times as many postcards as it did, and by Sunday 179 had been sold. How many postcards are on the rack now?
w10_T4_001265: A bakery cut 9 large cakes into 111 slices each for a wedding. The guests ate 925 slices during the reception. A further 65 slices were boxed up and taken home by the family. The wedding had 300 guests. The slices that were left were shared equally between the 3 kitchen staff. How many slices did one member of the kitchen staff receive?
w10_T4_001270: A bus depot had 17 ticket rolls in the office, but 3 of them were water-damaged and thrown out. Each of the good rolls holds 5 books of tickets. The depot's oldest bus is 30 years old. Over the month 66 books of tickets were issued to drivers and 1 book was lost. A supplier then delivered 44 more books. Half of the drivers work only at weekends. How many books of tickets does the depot have now?
w10_T4_001272: A leisure centre records its swimming sessions in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning 225 floats were shared equally between its 3 pools, and the main pool took its share. Before lunch 47 of the main pool's floats were taken to a school gala. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 39 floats to the main pool. That evening the gala returned 47 floats to the same pool. How many floats does the main pool have now?
w10_T4_001273: Rita's dog eats more treats than Sam's dog does. Rita had 28 treats in the tin, and 3 of them were crushed and thrown away. Sam then doubled the number of treats in the tin with a bag he had bought. A neighbour added 7 home-baked treats, and the pet shop delivered another 67. How many treats are in the tin now?
w10_T4_001274: The window box on the school steps is the only place the herb pots are kept. It held 32 pots in May, and 28 of them were taken indoors for a cookery lesson. In June a gardener doubled the number of pots in the box. The school day starts at 9 o'clock. In July a garden centre donated 48 pots for the box and a parent added 18 more. The council now wants 4 window boxes, each holding as many pots as this one. How many herb pots will the 4 window boxes need?
w10_T4_001275: A village hall started December with 54 baubles in its decoration box. A shopkeeper donated 29 baubles and a family gave 61 more. Half of the baubles in the box are red. The hall then bought enough for each of its 7 trees to carry as many baubles as the box held. The parish is decorating 5 halls in exactly the same way. How many baubles does the parish need in total?
w10_T4_001278: On Monday morning a roofer counted 145 tiles on his trailer, and 51 of them were cracked and set aside. Each good tile was then cut into 8 smaller slips for the ridge work. Before lunch the slips were shared equally between the 4 roofs being repaired, and the first roof took its share. In the afternoon the merchant supplied 8 times that many slips for the rest of the street. That evening another crew returned 45 slips and a supplier dropped off 72 more. How many slips does the roofer have now?
